suggestions.reason: Uses deprecated TestBed.flushEffects() throughout (16+ occurrences) — this API is deprecated in Angular 21. No assertion checks for deprecated API usage
Imports Todo from './todo.service' (line 8) which would fail since the interface is defined in the same file. Self-contained specs should not have external imports for inlined types

The without-skill version actually performs better on eval 6 because it uses HttpClient for addTodo (making POST interceptable), while the with-skill version uses native fetch. This suggests the skill needs explicit guidance on keeping all HTTP in HttpClient for testability

eval_feedback.overall: Paradoxically, the without-skill output is more correct for the addTodo testing scenario. The skill actively hurts here because it doesn't guide httpResource testing patterns.
